As we mentioned, we are disappointed that the game did not stay consistent spirit wise and in fair mindedness. We decided not to take a point away but think it important to mention again.

Thank you for the game. As we mentioned in the circle, we thought there was a general lack of knowledge of rules, which slowed the game multiple times. We also felt that the players were not very attentive during calls and took the opportunity to talk about strategy during the resolution time.

Congratulations Singapore !

Great great game, thank you again ! 
Xoxox
France.

Thank you for this game, it was once again very intense. Thank you for having this conversation before the game, we felt that both team were willing to learn and to have a very spirited game.

Thank you GB for this game and congratulations.

Safe travels home !
Xoxox 
France

spiritreceived.comments:
Please go over pick rule as a team
Thank you for the game

It yas great that both teams were able to have a lot of communication on field. Calls were solved smoothly and some of the coments that were made on the first half were solved during the second half of the game. Thank you for your respect and an exciting game!

The definitions of "Double Team," "Travel," and "Marking Infraction" are not very clear (e.g., Double Team: within three (3) meters without also guarding another offensive player). Additionally, when calling a travel violation, it was not clearly explained how the traveling occurred, which we believe needs to be expressed more clearly. There was also a noticeable lack of patience when resolving the call. when indicating a foul, there were no hand signals used.and sideline distance.

There were a few instances where body language was not ideal during calls, and some calls took longer to resolve. However, we appreciate that their teammates helped to call out these instances  to correct each other :)

For attitude: thank you for the apologies r.e. Sideline comments, however we do feel this plus reactions to calls warranted a lower score

For fair mindedness/ use of rules: relating to difference between contact willing to receive / give across the team, and as discussed we felt fouls were called whilst contesting for the same space when it advantaged you
Thank you France for an intense game. An improvement seen in both sides regards to spirit compared to the last game. Some great comms with calls and good discussions had.
Congrats!!For Fair-mindedness :There are some guiding calls from the sideline, and for stall outs, signals should be made as soon as possible.
